Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Recommended Items:
- Beach towels
- Water bottles
- Snorkeling equipment (for Hanauma Bay on June 12)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for hiking and touring)
- Light jacket for evenings
- Sunglasses and hat
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Waterproof phone case
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

Activity-Specific Items:
- Hiking boots/shoes (Diamond Head - June 13)
- Snorkel gear (Hanauma Bay - June 12)
- Kayaking gear (Kailua Beach - June 18)
- Nice outfit for Luau experience (June 16)
- Spa attire (hotel spa - June 17)

Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets
- Hotel reservations
- Travel insurance
- Credit cards and cash
